blocks.title: What is this file?
blocks.what: This file runs a Pod you can look up names from. It comes from the core v1 API.
blocks.why: Looking up the web Service from inside a Pod shows how apps find each other.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the file, because it cannot tell what you want to create.
blocks.comment: What to create: a Pod to test names from

blocks.title: Give it a name
blocks.why: You use the name to run commands inside it with kubectl exec.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the file, because every object needs a name.
blocks.comment: A name to run commands in
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dns-client

blocks.title: A container that waits
blocks.what: A small busybox container sleeps for an hour, so you can run commands inside it.
blocks.why: busybox includes nslookup and wget, the tools for checking names and fetching pages.
blocks.ifRemoved: Without containers, Kubernetes rejects the Pod.
blocks.comment: A busybox container that waits for your commands
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dns-client
spec:
  containers:
    - name: client
      image: busybox:1.37.0
      command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]

blocks.title: The short name
blocks.what: SHORT_URL holds the Service name alone: http://web.
blocks.why: Inside the same namespace, the Service name is enough. Cluster DNS fills in the rest.
blocks.ifRemoved: The variable is gone. The short name still works if you type it yourself.
blocks.comment: The short name: works from the same namespace
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dns-client
spec:
  containers:
    - name: client
      image: busybox:1.37.0
      command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
      env:
        - name: SHORT_URL
          value: http://web

blocks.title: The full name
blocks.what: FULL_URL holds the full name: the Service, its namespace, then svc.cluster.local.
blocks.why: The full name works from any namespace, so apps elsewhere in the cluster use it.
blocks.ifRemoved: The variable is gone. The full name still works if you type it yourself.
blocks.comment: The full name: works from any namespace
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dns-client
spec:
  containers:
    - name: client
      image: busybox:1.37.0
      command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
      env:
        - name: SHORT_URL
          value: http://web
        - name: FULL_URL
          value: http://web.default.svc.cluster.local

notes.apiVersion: The API group and version that define this kind. Pods are in the core v1 API.
notes.kind: The type of object to create. A Pod runs one or more containers together.
notes.metadata: Details that identify the object, such as its name.
notes.metadata.name: The Pod’s name. kubectl exec uses it to run commands inside.
notes.spec: The desired state: what you want Kubernetes to run.
notes.spec.containers: The containers in this Pod. Each list item starts with a dash.
notes.spec.containers[].name: The container’s name. It must be unique within the Pod.
notes.spec.containers[].image: busybox, a small image with nslookup and wget, at a fixed version.
notes.spec.containers[].command: Sleep for an hour, so the container keeps running while you test.
notes.spec.containers[].env: Environment variables for the container. Apps often read addresses from them.
notes.spec.containers[].env[].name: The variable’s name.
notes.spec.containers[].env[].value: The variable’s value: an address made from the Service’s DNS name.

questions.question: In web.default.svc.cluster.local, what is default?
answers: The namespace the Service is in
questions.explain: A full name is the Service name, its namespace, then svc.cluster.local.

questions.question: Why does http://web work without the rest of the name?
answers: The Pod’s search list adds default.svc.cluster.local
questions.explain: Each Pod gets a search list in /etc/resolv.conf. Short names are tried with each ending in turn.

questions.question: An app in the shop namespace needs this Service. Which address should it use?
questions.explain: From shop, the short name looks in shop first. The full name says default.

fix.explain: No Service called web exists in the shop namespace. The name points to the wrong namespace.
